description: Queue an image-to-video generation for one montage clip. Spends credits: call it only after the user agreed in chat. Returns the generation_id to poll with get_generation_status.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds; defaults to 5

generate_audio.description: Include audio in the delivered video. False delivers a silent file; fixed-audio providers are muted after generation at the same credits.

generation_result_id.description: Existing generation result ID to use as the source image; provide exactly one source

image_url.description: HTTPS source image URL; provide exactly one source

last_frame_url.description: Optional final-frame image URL for supported video models

model.description: Video model slug or supported model name

prompt.description: Optional motion prompt for the video clip

uploaded_file_id.description: Uploaded file ID to use as the source image; provide exactly one source

name: mcp_generate_clip
title: Generate Montage Clip
